_comment: Curated, plain-language changelog entries (OM-Infra#86). One object per shipped/in-testing change. surface: app|website|staff-tools|stock-platform. status: shipped|in-testing. date: YYYY-MM-DD (merge/ship date; in-testing may use the current week). ref: 'repo#number'. why: optional 'why it matters' line for high-impact items. Newest first within each group. See README for the voice guide.

entries.title: Test notifications kept away from real customers
entries.body: Making sure any notification sent while we're testing the app never reaches a real customer — the test app and the live app stay fully separate.

entries.title: App building-blocks refreshed
entries.body: Swapped two ageing parts of the app for maintained versions. No visible change intended — being checked on real devices before it goes out.

entries.title: Managers now see every ticket on the dashboard
entries.body: The Ticket Dashboard was only showing an admin the tickets they'd raised themselves. It now shows the whole team's tickets in one place — the way the shared view was always meant to work.
entries.why: Managers get the full picture of what's open across the team, instead of a partial one.

entries.title: Attach any file type in internal support
entries.body: Staff can now attach PDFs, Word, Excel and CSV files — not just images — when raising an internal support request.

entries.title: A safe test environment for the app is live
entries.body: The team can now try app changes on real phones — using a test store and test payments — before a single customer sees them. It installs alongside the real app, so nothing is put at risk.
entries.why: The app is ~80% of our orders. Testing safely first means far fewer surprises reaching customers.

entries.title: App test builds are ~40% faster
entries.body: Cut the time to produce a test build of the app from about 20 minutes to about 12 — so fixes reach the team's phones sooner.

entries.title: New Category Availability Dashboard — live
entries.body: Store and category teams can now see product availability across all stores in one place, weighted by revenue, at category.organicmandya.club. Top-75 availability is tracking at ~94%.

entries.title: Fixed "sold out" showing on items that were actually in stock
entries.body: Corrected the stock sync between our systems so in-stock products stop being hidden from customers. Restored availability on hundreds of products.
entries.why: Every wrongly-hidden product was a lost sale. This directly protects revenue.

entries.title: "Get the app" smart link is live
entries.body: Visitors to organicmandya.com/pages/app are now sent to the right app store automatically — Android or iPhone — in one tap.

entries.title: Combo and bundle products are buyable again
entries.body: Multi-item combos were wrongly showing "sold out" even when every part was in stock. Their availability is now worked out from their components, so bundles you can actually fulfil show as available.

entries.title: Stock now checks and repairs itself every hour
entries.body: The system that decides whether a product shows in stock now reconciles against our live inventory every hour and fills any gaps automatically — so "sold out" reflects reality instead of a stale value.

entries.title: Stores hear new orders out loud
entries.body: The Store Dashboard now announces each new order aloud, so staff don't miss one during a busy rush.

entries.title: One place to track every support ticket
entries.body: A new admin dashboard shows every issue raised across the business with its current status, so nothing slips through the cracks.

entries.title: We stop oversells at checkout
entries.body: Checkout now checks live stock for the customer's own area before taking the order, so we don't sell something the nearby store can't actually fulfil.

entries.title: Your login is stored more securely
entries.body: The app now keeps your sign-in in the phone's secure storage instead of ordinary storage — a safer place for it to live, and it's properly cleared when you log out.

entries.title: The app no longer records sensitive details in its logs
entries.body: Cleaned up the app's internal diagnostic logs so things like one-time codes, tokens and account details are never written down — even on test builds handed to the team.

entries.title: Staff dashboards refresh faster
entries.body: Key store and leadership dashboards now update every 15 minutes instead of every couple of hours, so the numbers you're looking at are fresher.

entries.title: A second way to pay is being tested
entries.body: Adding PayU alongside the current card option at checkout, so there's a reliable fallback if one is slow. Being tested on our staging store now.

entries.title: A leaner, better-maintained app
entries.body: Removed unused and abandoned code from the app — including three payment kits we never used — for a smaller download, fewer security risks and an app that's easier to keep healthy.

entries.title: Dashboards now check themselves after every update
entries.body: After each update, the Category Availability Dashboard automatically confirms everything it needs is actually live — so a broken screen gets caught by us, not by you.

entries.title: Wallet history updates instantly after a top-up
entries.body: After you add money, your recent transactions now refresh on the spot — no more leaving the screen and coming back to see them.

entries.title: New engineering foundations — to build faster and safer
entries.body: Through June and July we put the groundwork in place behind the scenes: one secure home for every password and key, automatic checks on every change before it can go out, and safe one-click deployments with a quick way to roll back. None of it shows up on a screen, but it's what lets everything below ship quickly without breaking what's already live.

entries.title: Staff can report an issue from inside the tools
entries.body: A built-in "Report an Issue" form lets any staff member log a problem — with where it happened and a screenshot or video — straight to the team, no email needed.

entries.title: Every reported issue gets a tracking number and live status
entries.body: When you report an issue you now get a tracking number, and the form shows its current status and who's on it — so you can see it's being handled.

entries.title: Store and leadership dashboards load faster
entries.body: Moved the heaviest sales dashboards onto a quicker data path, so they open in a couple of seconds instead of the long wait they used to have.

entries.title: Dashboards flag a stale number before it reaches a leader
entries.body: Added a safeguard that spots when a dashboard's data hasn't refreshed and warns us — so nobody makes a call on yesterday's figure thinking it's today's.

entries.title: Dashboards you've opened before come back instantly
entries.body: The staff tools now remember the data you last loaded, so returning to a dashboard shows immediately while fresh numbers load in the background.

entries.title: A health monitor for our automated jobs
entries.body: A new admin page watches the behind-the-scenes jobs that keep data flowing and flags any that stop — so a silent failure gets caught early, not days later.

entries.title: Orders now route to the correct store
entries.body: Fixed a set of cases where orders were being sent to the wrong store, and pinned down one canonical store list so it stays right.

entries.title: The top-sellers list tells us when it's out of date
entries.body: The monthly top-selling-products list now shows a clear warning (and skips its email) if it hasn't refreshed, instead of quietly serving stale data.

entries.title: We now measure lost sales from out-of-stock refunds
entries.body: A new metric tracks orders refunded because an item wasn't actually available — turning "we lost some sales" into a number we can act on.

entries.title: Sign in to the Category Dashboard with your Microsoft account
entries.body: The new availability dashboard uses your existing Microsoft work login, and shows each person only what their role should see.

entries.title: Export the availability table to a spreadsheet
entries.body: One click downloads the store/SKU availability table as a spreadsheet, so category owners can work the gaps offline.

entries.title: See availability trend vs last period and the 90% target
entries.body: The dashboard now charts how availability is moving over time against the previous period and the 90% goal — not just today's snapshot.

entries.title: Manage dashboard access from a screen
entries.body: Admins can now add and change who can see the dashboard from a simple screen, instead of someone running a script behind the scenes.

entries.title: Group availability by parent category, with drill-down
entries.body: Availability can now be rolled up by parent category and opened up level by level, so you can go from the big picture to a single SKU.

entries.title: The app only connects over secure links
entries.body: Turned off plain, unencrypted connections app-wide, so everything the app sends and receives now travels over a secure channel.

entries.title: The app rejects tampered settings
entries.body: Added a check that refuses any configuration the app receives if it's been altered or corrupted — a guard against someone slipping in bad settings.

entries.title: Logging out now fully clears your session
entries.body: Fixed a case where a sign-in detail could linger after logout — logging out now clears it completely, so the next person on the phone starts fresh.

entries.title: Co-Op membership join, redesigned
entries.body: Rebuilt the Co-Op join screen to the approved design, with a clear add-to-cart step and confirmation, so joining is smoother and easier to follow.

entries.title: Sort and filter the product list
entries.body: You can now sort and filter within a category in the app, making it quicker to find what you want.

entries.title: Safer app releases
entries.body: App updates now go out gradually to a small share of users first, so if anything's off we can catch it before it reaches everyone.

entries.title: A refreshed, consistent app look
entries.body: Rolling out a shared design system so screens across the app look and behave consistently. Being built and checked in stages.

entries.title: Rotating announcements at the top of the site
entries.body: The website's top bar now rotates through up to three announcements and shows properly on phones, without the layout jumping.

entries.title: Cleaner product cards
entries.body: Tidied up product cards — no more "-0%" badges on full-price items, and consistent image framing across the grid and carousels.

entries.title: Joining the Co-Op adds to cart with a clear confirmation
entries.body: The Co-Op membership buttons on the site now add to your cart and confirm with a small message, then return you where you were.

entries.title: The website loads lighter
entries.body: Removed an unused mapping library that was adding about 254 KB to every page — so the site loads a little faster for everyone.

entries.title: "We don't deliver here yet" now reads differently from "sold out"
entries.body: On a product page, an item that simply isn't delivered to your area no longer looks the same as one that's out of stock — clearer for shoppers outside our delivery zones.

entries.title: A weekly check on catalog accuracy and lost demand
entries.body: A read-only audit now reviews the product catalog for mismatches and estimates demand we're losing to stock gaps, per store — so we can fix the biggest ones first.

entries.title: A faster new website, being built behind the scenes
entries.body: We're rebuilding organicmandya.com on our own faster foundation, page by page, so we depend less on third-party platforms. It's being built and tested privately — the live site is unchanged for now.
